facts.statement: The genus Plesiotylosaurus was named by Camp in 1942.
Fossils of Plesiotylosaurus were found in the Middle Maastrichtian Moreno Formation in California.
facts.quote: recovered from deposits of Middle Maastrichtian age in the Moreno Formation in California

facts.statement: Plesiotylosaurus means "near Tylosaurus" and is an extinct genus of marine lizard in the mosasaur family.
facts.quote: Plesiotylosaurus, meaning "near Tylosaurus", is an extinct genus of marine lizard belonging to the mosasaur family

facts.statement: Plesiotylosaurus is classified within the Mosasaurinae subfamily alongside Mosasaurus and Prognathodon.
facts.quote: It is classified as part of the Mosasaurinae subfamily, alongside genera like Mosasaurus and Prognathodon

facts.statement: The holotype's lower jaw measures 98 cm, suggesting the animal reached an estimated length of about 6 meters.
facts.quote: The lower jaw of the holotype skull measures 98 cm in length, which would give the whole animal an estimated length of about 6 m

facts.statement: Plesiotylosaurus had elongated jaws and a robust skull similar to Prognathodon, indicating a distinct prey preference.
facts.quote: The jaws of Plesiotylosaurus were elongated and its skull was quite robust, similar to Prognathodon, which suggests a distinct prey preference

facts.statement: A 2009 study by Lindgren analyzed the cranial osteology of Plesiotylosaurus using the holotype skull LACM 2759 and specimen UCMP 137249.
facts.quote: Lindgren (2009) did a comprehensive study on the cranial osteology of Plesiotylosaurus based on the holotype skull, LACM 2759, and another recently described cranial specimen, UCMP 137249

facts.statement: Plesiotylosaurus possessed a solid bony rostrum, a wide internarial bar, a long maxillo-premaxillary suture, an overlapping postorbitofrontal process, and a long narrow anterior mandibular channel.
facts.quote: These characteristics include having a solid, bony, rostrum at the tip of the snout and mandibles, a wide and virtually unconstricted internarial bar that arises from a transversely rectangular base on the posterior face of the dentigerous portion of the premaxilla, a maxillo-premaxillary suture that forms a relatively long junction between the tooth-bearing bones of the upper jaw, an anterior postorbitofrontal process that forms a broadly overlapping flange beneath the supraorbital wing of the prefrontal and an anterior mandibular channel that is developed into a long and narrow slit

facts.statement: Lindgren identified the shared cranial characteristics between Plesiotylosaurus and Tylosaurinae as an example of convergent evolution.
facts.quote: Lindgren considered these shared characteristics to be an obvious example of convergent evolution

facts.statement: Plesiotylosaurus is most frequently classified as a mosasaurine mosasaur closely related to the genus Prognathodon.
facts.quote: Plesiotylosaurus is most frequently recovered as a mosasaurine mosasaur sharing close relations with the genus Prognathodon

facts.statement: Plesiotylosaurus lived during the Maastrichtian stage, between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Plesiotylosaurus is the subfamily Mosasaurinae.
Plesiotylosaurus belongs to the family Mosasauridae.
Plesiotylosaurus is classified within the class Reptilia.
